requirement: Create an antibiotic: the referenced antibiotic group must exist and must not be soft-deleted, then map the command (which also builds the standard dose), persist the antibiotic with its dosage, and return the new ID with Created status.

preconditions.text: A live antibiotic group exists for the requested group ID
The requested group ID does not match any live group

inputs.text: Amoxicillin, Access classification, oral standard dose, live group
Meropenem, Watch classification, intravenous standard dose, live group
Ciprofloxacin with an unknown group ID
Colistin with a soft-deleted group ID

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new antibiotic ID
The antibiotic and its single standard dose are persisted with the requested fields
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic group ID not exists' error
No antibiotic and no dosage are created when the group check fails

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing group is returned as a failed Result
